User: 'Just built out Rootly and it's fantastic product. JJ and team are responsive and heavily engaged with customers... Having trialed Rootly against competing products Rootly won out for the customer engagement. The competition just wasn't responsive.'

User: after implementing Rootly, incident volume increased rapidly as teams began treating issues as real incidents; though metrics looked worse, it actually led to better problem management and stability.
Multiple commenters complained about Rootly's lack of upfront pricing: 'no pricing, no thanks' and 'the lack of transparency on cost led me to immediately dismiss it as an option.'

Commenter questioned Rootly's value beyond basic automation: 'how is this more than a glorified Slack workflow to a generic ticketing system? ... This could be easily done with an engineer/tech following a runbook.'
Feedback on Rootly's Slack-centric design: 'why base everything on Slack? ... it indirectly adds cost to your product; if I want to use Rootly I also have to pay for Slack (which is expensive).'

User comparing workflow preference: 'Took a quick look at your loom. Very cool. In practice, we prefer just looking through a single channel with threads, but perhaps that's because we're a small team.'

Commenter skeptical of Rootly On-Call launch: 'Not even the best competitor to pagerduty released in the last 72 hours... Any engineering team worth their weight realises that its not a drop-in solution to PD and barely solves any hard problems.'
User praised Rootly's CEO JJ as unusually customer-focused: 'This dude is relentless... I don't know I've seen a CEO as deeply customer focused in quite some time, he really is a pro.'
